Punchline.Translated: 帮助你填满青魔法师技能书

Description.Original: Adds a window to show all Blue Magic, letting you search for spells and then teleport or mark the location on your map or open the dutyfinder. Can also mark mobs in world that drop spells you need.
Description.Translated: 添加一个窗口显示所有青魔法，让你可以搜索技能，然后传送或在地图上标记位置，或打开任务搜索器。还可以在世界中标记掉落你所需技能的怪物。

Name.Translated: 更好的无边框窗口模式

Punchline.Original: Make borderless window mode work well with aero shortcuts
Punchline.Translated: 让无边框窗口模式与aero快捷键良好配合

Description.Original: Borderless window can now be properly minimized (by clicking on taskbar or by win+down shortcut); when moved between monitors (win+shift+left/right), resolution is updated automatically.
Description.Translated: 无边框窗口现在可以正确最小化（通过点击任务栏或win+向下快捷键）；在显示器之间移动时（win+shift+左/右），分辨率会自动更新。

Punchline.Original: Improve your Bozja suffering. Maybe.
Punchline.Translated: 改善你的博兹雅受苦体验。也许吧。

Description.Original:
Features:
• Resistance relic guide and tracking.
• Info about Lost Actions, Fragments, FATEs/CE, Field Notes e.g. location, drops, marketboard price, fate chains, mettle rewards, exp rewards, etc.
• Node graph viewer.
• Weather forecast.
• Alarms based on time, weather, and FATE/CE.
• Custom loadouts planning, saving, and sharing. Featuring recommended loadouts from many communities.
• Overlay for Lost Find Cache. Filterable by name, role, fragment, weight, and Custom Loadout of choice.
• View Bozja stats and Cache from anywhere. Customisable alert for actions that are running low.
• Delubrum Reginae (Savage) resources and communities.
Description.Translated:
功能：
• 义军遗物指南和追踪。
• 关于失传技能、碎晶、FATE/CE、战果记录的信息，例如位置、掉落、市场板价格、FATE链、战果奖励、经验奖励等。
• 节点图查看器。
• 天气预报表。
• 基于时间、天气和FATE/CE的警报。
• 自定义配装规划、保存和分享。包含来自许多社区的推荐配装。
• 失传搜寻缓存覆盖层。可按名称、职能、碎晶、重量和所选自定义配装筛选。
• 随时随地查看博兹雅统计和缓存。可自定义低存量技能警报。
• 女王古殿（零式）资源和社区。

Punchline.Original: Hides toast notifications you don't want to see.
Punchline.Translated: 隐藏你不想看到的提示通知。

Description.Original: Hides toast notifications you don't want to see.
Description.Translated: 隐藏你不想看到的提示通知。

Punchline.Original: Save and load unlimited camera and lighting presets in Group Pose
Punchline.Translated: 在集体动作中保存和加载无限的相机和光照预设

Description.Original: This plugin lets you save unlimited camera & lighting configurations/presets in Group Pose at a time, vastly improving over the vanilla feature which lets you save only one of each.
Description.Translated: 此插件让你在集体动作中一次保存无限的相机和光照配置/预设，大幅改进原版功能（原版每种只能保存一个）。

Punchline.Original: CashFlow is a plugin that will log your trades, sales and purchases.
Punchline.Translated: CashFlow 是一个记录你的交易、销售和购买的插件。

Description.Original: CashFlow is a plugin that will log your trades, sales and purchases.
Description.Translated: CashFlow 是一个记录你的交易、销售和购买的插件。

Punchline.Original: Play sounds and highlight text based on defined filters.
Punchline.Translated: 根据定义的过滤器播放声音并高亮文本。

Description.Original: Play sounds and highlight text based on defined filters.
Description.Translated: 根据定义的过滤器播放声音并高亮文本。

Punchline.Original: Add sender target name in chat messages.
Punchline.Translated: 在聊天消息中添加发送者目标名称。

Description.Original: Add sender target name in chat messages and displays nearly player targets
Description.Translated: 在聊天消息中添加发送者目标名称，并显示附近的玩家目标

Punchline.Original: Places flag marker on map from coordinates in chat.
Punchline.Translated: 根据聊天中的坐标在地图上放置标记。

Description.Original:
Places flag marker on map from coordinates in chat.
Opens map with given coordinates for current or given zone.
See "/coord" for configuration and usage info.
Description.Translated:
根据聊天中的坐标在地图上放置标记。
为当前或指定区域打开带有给定坐标的地图。
查看“/coord”以获取配置和使用信息。

Punchline.Original: Know how far they talk from.
Punchline.Translated: 了解他们说话的距离有多远。

Description.Original: This plugin will change message in the chat within the "say" channel (or other ranged channels), darkening people when they're far from you.
Description.Translated: 此插件会改变聊天中“说话”频道（或其他有距离限制的频道）的消息，当人们离你较远时将其变暗。

Punchline.Original: Saves and filters chats.
Punchline.Translated: 保存并过滤聊天记录。

Description.Original: Allows for saving chat conversations, separated by groups of people and chat types.
Description.Translated: 允许保存聊天对话，按人群分组和聊天类型分开。

Punchline.Original: Ingame chat translator.
Punchline.Translated: 游戏内聊天翻译器。

Description.Original: Ingame chat translator.
Description.Translated: 游戏内聊天翻译器。

Punchline.Original: Dynamic Framerate Limiter, changes fps limit depend on what you are doing
Punchline.Translated: 动态帧率限制器，根据你正在做的事情改变帧率上限

Description.Original: Tired of your GPU melting your face off while just running around? Why render at 240 FPS when you're just staring at that gathering node? Fret no more! Chill Frames allows you dynamically limit your framerate when doing unimportant tasks!
Description.Translated: 厌倦了只是四处跑动时 GPU 快把脸烤化了？当你只是盯着那个采集点时，为什么要以 240 FPS 渲染？别再烦恼了！Chill Frames 允许你在做不重要的事情时动态限制帧率！

Punchline.Original: Customizable, Source Engine-styled position info
Punchline.Translated: 可自定义的、Source 引擎风格的位置信息

Description.Original: Shows your exact position, rotation, and velocity on screen. Based off of the cl_showpos command from the Source Engine.
Description.Translated: 在屏幕上显示你的精确位置、朝向和速度。基于 Source 引擎的 cl_showpos 命令。

Punchline.Original: Seek visual serenity in the midst of Chaos
Punchline.Translated: 在混沌中寻求视觉上的宁静

Description.Original: Automatically adjusts the Battle Effects settings according to Party size.
Description.Translated: 根据队伍人数自动调整战斗特效设置。

Punchline.Original: Shows how many scrips and items you would receive if you turn in your current inventory.
Punchline.Translated: 显示你上交当前背包物品后能获得多少票据和物品

Description.Original: Shows how many scrips and items you would receive if you turn in your current inventory.
Description.Translated: 显示你上交当前背包物品后能获得多少票据和物品。

Punchline.Original: Track, Discover and Interact with your Collections in game
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内追踪、发现并与你的收藏互动

Description.Original:
Collections provides an interface to track, discover and interact with your Collections in game.
Integrates with Glamour systems (Preview, Create Sets, Glamour Plates).
Supports: Glamour, Mounts, Minions, Emotes, Hairstyles, Triple Triad, Blue Mage, Bardings, Framer Kits, Orchestrions, Outfits, Fashion Accessories, Facewear.
Description.Translated:
Collections 提供了一个界面，用于在游戏内追踪、发现并与你的收藏互动。
与幻化系统集成（预览、创建套装、幻化模板）。
支持：幻化、坐骑、宠物、情感动作、发型、九宫幻卡、青魔法师、坐骑装甲、相框、管弦乐谱、套装、时尚配饰、面部配饰。

Punchline.Original: Keep your mouse cursor contained during combat!
Punchline.Translated: 在战斗中锁定你的鼠标光标！

Description.Original: Automatically changes the 'limit mouse operation to game window' setting when entering/exiting combat.
Description.Translated: 在进入/退出战斗时自动更改“将鼠标操作限制在游戏窗口内”设置。

Punchline.Original: Monodimensional compass for your adventures.
Punchline.Translated: 为你冒险准备的一维指南针。

Description.Original:
Check-out the repository for steps on how to report missing/wrong filter
and hiding options. Have a look at the FAQ tab in the config window
after install for common caveats.
Description.Translated: 查看仓库以了解如何报告缺失/错误的过滤和隐藏选项。安装后请查看配置窗口中的常见问题标签页以了解常见注意事项。

Punchline.Original: Automatically rearrange party list for TOP.
Punchline.Translated: 为 TOP 自动重新排列小队列表。

Description.Original: Rearrange party list from left to right: /conga
Description.Translated: 从左到右重新排列小队列表：/conga

Punchline.Original: Get aurally rewarded when you get commended on duties.
Punchline.Translated: 在副本中获得点赞时获得听觉奖励。

Description.Original:
Get aurally rewarded when you get commended on duties.

Comes with default sounds for when you get commended by 1/3, 2/3, 3/3 or all seven members of the duty you were in, but you can set custom sounds for each type of trigger by opening /congratsconfig.

The fractioned values are in relation to how many of those members could commend you (i.e. excluding those that were in your party before joining the duty).
Description.Translated:
在副本中获得点赞时获得听觉奖励。

自带默认音效，分别对应你被所在副本的 1/3、2/3、3/3 或全部七名成员点赞的情况，但你可以通过打开 /congratsconfig 为每种触发类型设置自定义音效。

分数值对应的是可能给你点赞的成员数量（即不包括在加入副本前就已在你小队中的成员）。

Punchline.Original: Help you record duty and who you met.
Punchline.Translated: 帮助你记录任务和遇到的人。

Description.Original:
Remember to change setting according to your need.
Use the Settings button to enter analyze window.
Description.Translated:
记得根据需要更改设置。
使用设置按钮进入分析窗口。

Punchline.Original: Import map coordinates to echo chat.
Punchline.Translated: 将地图坐标导入到回显聊天中。

Description.Original: Import map coordinates from various sources (e.g. Siren Hunts or Bear Toolkit) and dump them into echo chat. Use /ci to open the dialog box.
Description.Translated: 从各种来源（例如 Siren Hunts 或 Bear Toolkit）导入地图坐标并将其转储到回显聊天中。使用 /ci 打开对话框。

Punchline.Original: Simulate crafts, create computer-assisted macros, and get mid-craft suggestions from the comfort of your own game!
Punchline.Translated: 模拟制作、创建计算机辅助宏，并在自己的游戏中获得制作中的建议！

Description.Original: Allows you to generate macros and simulate all sorts of crafts without having to open another app. Open your crafting log to get started!
Description.Translated: 允许你生成宏并模拟各种制作，而无需打开另一个应用程序。打开你的制作日志即可开始！

Punchline.Original: Customize the Cross Hotbar!
Punchline.Translated: 自定义交叉热键栏！

Description.Original:
This plugin provides various customizations for the look and feel of the Cross Hotbar.

-Split up the left/right hotbars
-Display Expanded Hold Controls Separately
-Customize colors and element positions
-Greater control over which sets your extra bars are mapped to
Description.Translated:
此插件为交叉热键栏的外观和感觉提供了各种自定义选项。

-拆分左/右热键栏
-单独显示扩展按住控制
-自定义颜色和元素位置
-更好地控制额外栏映射到哪些套装

Punchline.Original: Stream internet radio stations while playing FFXIV
Punchline.Translated: 在玩 FFXIV 时播放网络电台。

Description.Original: Listen to your favorite internet radio stations directly in-game. Browse stations and manage your favorites. Use /cradio to open the radio player
Description.Translated: 直接在游戏中收听你最喜欢的网络电台。浏览电台并管理你的收藏。使用 /cradio 打开电台播放器。

Punchline.Original: Discover how to use all the in-game currencies.
Punchline.Translated: 了解如何使用所有游戏内货币。

Description.Original: Never wonder 'What should I do with this?' again. Access real-time prices from Universalis, identify missing collectibles tied to your currencies, and unlock new possibilities for utilizing your in-game resources effectively.
Description.Translated: 再也不用想知道“我该拿这个做什么？”。从 Universalis 获取实时价格，识别与你的货币相关的缺失收藏品，并解锁有效利用游戏内资源的新可能性。

Punchline.Original: Shows an overlay and/or sends alerts when your held currency items (or non-currency items) match configurable rules. A spiritual successor to CurrencyAlert.
Punchline.Translated: 当你的持有货币物品（或非货币物品）匹配可配置规则时，显示叠加层和/或发送警报。CurrencyAlert 的精神续作。

Description.Original: Provides a configurable overlay, configurable alerts, and a powerful rule system for displaying how many currency (or non-currency) items you have (or don't have). A spiritual successor to CurrencyAlert.
Description.Translated: 提供可配置的叠加层、可配置的警报以及强大的规则系统，用于显示你拥有（或不拥有）多少货币（或非货币）物品。CurrencyAlert 的精神续作。

Punchline.Original: Tweak the built-in 4-band EQ with custom presets.
Punchline.Translated: 使用自定义预设调整内置的 4 段均衡器。

Description.Original: Did you know that the EQ presets in the system settings are powered by a 4-band EQ? Let's make our own presets!
Description.Translated: 你知道系统设置中的均衡器预设是由 4 段均衡器驱动的吗？让我们制作自己的预设吧！

Punchline.Original: Enforces a custom resolution for the game, similar to NVIDIA DSR.
Punchline.Translated: 为游戏强制设定自定义分辨率，类似于 NVIDIA DSR。

Description.Original: Basic plugin that allows you to specify a custom resolution.
Description.Translated: 基础插件，允许你指定自定义分辨率。

Punchline.Original: Tools to make managing Linkshells and Cross-world Linkshells easier.
Punchline.Translated: 让管理通讯贝和跨服通讯贝更轻松的工具。

Description.Original: Formerly CWLSLastSeenTool. Tools to make managing Linkshells and Cross-world Linkshells easier. Primarily for keeping track of when you last see memebrs online but more functionality may be added as requested/when I am able. /shelltools to open.
Description.Translated: 原名 CWLSLastSeenTool。让管理通讯贝和跨服通讯贝更轻松的工具。主要用于记录你最后一次看到成员在线的时间，但如有需求/在我有能力时可能会添加更多功能。输入 /shelltools 打开。

Punchline.Original: Easily Track Daily and Weekly tasks
Punchline.Translated: 轻松追踪每日和每周任务

Description.Original: Automatically track and complete many daily and weekly tasks
Description.Translated: 自动追踪并完成许多每日和每周任务

Punchline.Original: Sync your character data from your main character to all others
Punchline.Translated: 将你主角色的角色数据同步到所有其他角色

Description.Original:
This plugin allows you to use your character data from your main character on all others.

In-game, use the configuration menu to choose your main character, the restart the game to start syncing!.
Description.Translated:
此插件允许你在所有其他角色上使用主角色的角色数据。

在游戏内，使用配置菜单选择你的主角色，然后重启游戏开始同步！。

Punchline.Original: Receive your chat messages via Discord.
Punchline.Translated: 通过 Discord 接收你的聊天消息。

Description.Original: This plugin allows you to receive your chat messages via Discord.
Description.Translated: 此插件允许你通过 Discord 接收你的聊天消息。

Punchline.Original: Find anything, go anywhere, in style.
Punchline.Translated: 以时尚的方式，找到任何东西，去往任何地方。

Description.Original:
Adds a convenient quick search akin to Spotlight that lets you open game windows, teleport, find wiki articles, and more.
Press Control + T to open the search window. This can be changed by searching for "Wotsit Settings".
Description.Translated:
添加一个类似聚光灯的便捷快速搜索，让你可以打开游戏窗口、传送、查找 wiki 文章等。
按 Control + T 打开搜索窗口。可以通过搜索“Wotsit Settings”来更改。

Punchline.Original: Show your character's job, level, name, and other details in your Discord status.
Punchline.Translated: 在 Discord 状态中显示你角色的职业、等级、名称和其他详情。

Description.Original: Show your zone, job, level, name, and world in your Discord status.
Description.Translated: 在 Discord 状态中显示你的区域、职业、等级、名称和服务器。

Punchline.Original: Classic puzzle game.
Punchline.Translated: 经典益智游戏。

Description.Original:
Logic puzzle in which you find and flag hidden mines.

Left click to uncover a square, right click to place a flag.
The game ends when all safe squares have been uncovered.
Click the smiley face to start a new game.
Description.Translated:
逻辑谜题，你需要找出并标记隐藏的地雷。

左键点击揭开方块，右键点击放置旗帜。
当所有安全方块都被揭开时游戏结束。
点击笑脸开始新游戏。

Punchline.Original: Modifies in-game fly-text for more (or less) damage information.
Punchline.Translated: 修改游戏内飞出的伤害数字，以显示更多（或更少）伤害信息。

Description.Original: Configurable options for in-game fly text color based on damage type, with additional settings for damage source and fly text decluttering options.
Description.Translated: 可配置游戏内飞出的伤害数字颜色，基于伤害类型，并提供伤害来源和飞出的伤害数字简化选项的额外设置。

Punchline.Original: Plugin to help with a number of dice games. Also offers games like Tic-Tac-Toe, Minesweeper and Bahamood.
Punchline.Translated: 帮助处理多种骰子游戏的插件。还提供井字棋、扫雷和巴哈姆特等游戏。

Description.Original:
## Modes
### Venue:
- Concise display of all concurrent players in a list-based format
- Supports multiple sorting types (min, max, nearest to)
- Highlight numbers based on regex matching

### DeathRoll:
- Supports multiple players
- Automatic checks to prevent number skipping

### Tournament (1v1 DeathRoll):
- Automatic bracket generation with byes to fill uneven
- Forfeit functionality if a player needs to leave

### Blackjack:
- Automatic reward calculation based on common rules
- Simplistic, or visual view of cards in play
- Automatic or manual player-based draw for cards

### Extra Features:
- Block or prevent players from partaking in any game
- Accept only /random or /dice commands

## Games
### Tic-Tac-Toe
- Play against your friends, or AI
- Easy, Medium, Hard
- 3x3, 4x4, 5x5

### Minesweeper
- Easy, Medium, Hard
- 8x8, 9x9, 16x16, 18x30
- Custom Games (planned)

More features are planned, following user feedback.
Description.Translated:
## 模式
### 场地：
- 以列表格式简洁显示所有同时参与的玩家
- 支持多种排序类型（最小、最大、最接近）
- 基于正则表达式匹配高亮数字

### 死亡骰：
- 支持多个玩家
- 自动检查以防止数字跳过

### 锦标赛（1v1 死亡骰）：
- 自动生成对阵表，用轮空填补不均匀
- 如果玩家需要离开，提供弃权功能

### 黑杰克号：
- 基于常见规则自动计算奖励
- 简单或可视化的牌局视图
- 自动或手动玩家抽牌

### 额外功能：
- 阻止或防止玩家参与任何游戏
- 仅接受 /random 或 /dice 命令

## 游戏
### 井字棋
- 与朋友或 AI 对战
- 简单、中等、困难
- 3x3、4x4、5x5

### 扫雷
- 简单、中等、困难
- 8x8、9x9、16x16、18x30
- 自定义游戏（计划中）

更多功能计划中，根据用户反馈。

Punchline.Original: Live monster data.
Punchline.Translated: 实时怪物数据。

Description.Original:
A live bestiary.
Shows target mob aggro type, a subjective threat level, status vulnerabilities, and a general overview of notable mechanics.
Threat level is meant to be taken with a grain of salt, is aimed towards solo players, and assumes a general familiarity with deep dungeon mechanics and the class being played.
Information is accurate to the best of my knowledge based on crowdsourced information, but I could use your help! Please open an issue on the GitHub if you'd like to correct inaccurate or untested data.
Originally DeepDungeonDex
Description.Translated:
实时怪物图鉴。
显示目标怪物的仇恨类型、主观威胁等级、状态弱点和显著机制的一般概述。
威胁等级仅供参考，针对单人玩家，并假设对次元城地下牢狱机制和所玩职业有一般了解。
信息基于众包信息，尽我所知准确，但我需要你的帮助！如果你想纠正不准确或未经测试的数据，请在 GitHub 上打开问题。
原为 DeepDungeonDex

Punchline.Original: Track things inside Deep Dungeons (Solo only).
Punchline.Translated: 追踪次元城地下牢狱内的内容（仅限单人）。

Description.Original:
-Keep track of the number of kills, coffers opened, regeneration potions consumed, potsherds obtained, total time and more.
-Examine the collected data.
-Scoring.
Description.Translated:
-追踪击杀数、打开的宝箱、消耗的再生药、获得的小块陶片、总时间等。
-检查收集的数据。
-评分。

Punchline.Original: Customizable UI elements to track cooldowns, status and more.
Punchline.Translated: 可自定义的 UI 元素，用于追踪冷却、状态等。

Description.Original: DelvCD provides highly customizable UI elements that can be used to track cooldows, status and more with configurable conditions.
Description.Translated: DelvCD 提供高度可自定义的 UI 元素，可用于追踪冷却、状态等，并具有可配置的条件。

Punchline.Original: A modern HUD replacement built for customization.
Punchline.Translated: 为自定义而构建的现代 HUD 替代品。

Description.Original: DelvUI provides a highly configurable HUD replacement and is highly inspired by ElvUI from WoW
Description.Translated: DelvUI 提供高度可配置的 HUD 替代品，深受 WoW 的 ElvUI 启发

Punchline.Original: Stops controller input from freezing randomly.
Punchline.Translated: 阻止控制器输入随机冻结。

Description.Original:
Stops controller input from freezing randomly by ensuring FFXIV only polls for controllers when one is actually connected or disconnected. Doesn't require any configuration.

Original plugin by PGGB, icon from Mutant Standard.
Description.Translated:
通过确保 FFXIV 仅在控制器实际连接或断开时轮询控制器，阻止控制器输入随机冻结。无需任何配置。

原插件由 PGGB 制作，图标来自 Mutant Standard。

Punchline.Original: Yet another useful calculator~
Punchline.Translated: 又一个有用的计算器~

Description.Original: Calculates your current sessions points and scrip reward
Description.Translated: 计算你当前会话的积分和票据奖励

Punchline.Original: Draw the compass directionals around the target for easier callouts
Punchline.Translated: 在目标周围绘制罗盘方向，便于报点

Description.Original: Draw the compass directionals around the target (boss relative or true north)
Description.Translated: 在目标周围绘制罗盘方向（以Boss为基准或正北）

Punchline.Original: Send message to friends from discord
Punchline.Translated: 从Discord向好友发送消息

Description.Original: Discord / FFXIV bot to send msg from discord to the game
Description.Translated: Discord / FFXIV机器人，用于从Discord向游戏内发送消息

Punchline.Original: The ultimate Ocean Fishing plugin.
Punchline.Translated: 终极出海垂钓插件。

Description.Original:
The ultimate Ocean Fishing plugin. Automatically suggests baits, logs each boat you're on, tracks progress to achievements, adds a global point leaderboard, and more!

Icon from the Mutant Standard project.
Description.Translated:
终极出海垂钓插件。自动推荐鱼饵，记录你每次出海的船只，追踪成就进度，添加全局积分排行榜等！

图标来自Mutant Standard项目。

Punchline.Original: Play a chime when someone comes into a house.
Punchline.Translated: 有人进入房屋时播放提示音。

Description.Original:
Play a chime when someone comes into a house, when they leave or when entering a house people are already inside.

Icon by Flaticon
Description.Translated:
当有人进入房屋、离开房屋，或进入已有人的房屋时播放提示音。

图标来自Flaticon

Punchline.Original: A plugin that ranks your performance based on your fundamentals in combat
Punchline.Translated: 根据你的战斗基本功为你评分的插件

Description.Original: A plugin that tries to add flavour to combat. You score by dealing damage and keeping your GCD rolling, and lose points if you are not greeding correctly. Now with dynamic BGM.
Description.Translated: 一个试图为战斗增添趣味的插件。通过造成伤害和保持GCD运转来得分，若贪输出不当则扣分。现已加入动态BGM。

Punchline.Original: Preview duty loot before it drops.
Punchline.Translated: 在掉落前预览副本战利品。

Description.Original: Preview duty loot before it drops.
Description.Translated: 在掉落前预览副本战利品。

Punchline.Original: Push notify to your device when your duty is ready
Punchline.Translated: 副本就绪时向你的设备推送通知

Description.Original: You can use this plugin to push notify to your device when your duty is ready
Description.Translated: 你可以使用此插件在副本就绪时向你的设备推送通知

Punchline.Original: Track your duty completion speeds with ease.
Punchline.Translated: 轻松追踪你的副本通关速度。

Description.Original: A simple speedrun timer for FFXIV duties.
Description.Translated: 一个简单的FFXIV副本速通计时器。

Punchline.Original: Automatically finely scales the game UI by resolution.

Punchline.Original: Complete combat countdown, pull timer and OBS overlay

Description.Original:
Finally, display all the numbers when starting a countdown!
Comes with an accurate pull timer that starts when you or any of your party members enter combat.

Features :
- Big countdown that displays all the numbers
- Customizable big-number textures (default, yellow, WoW style or custom files)
- Display combat time in the Server Info Bar, and/or a floating window
- OBS browser-source compatible page with countdown and current combat duration

Why the OBS thing ? I like having a big stylized stopwatch in my private recordings and that's about it.
See repository for more info.

Feel free so send me feedback, bugs and potential improvements! Check the about page in the plugin settings for more
info. Please report urgent feedback on GitHub or XIVLauncher Discord's support thread for this plugin.

更多信息请参见仓库。

Punchline.Original: Improvements to the in-game friend system, including login and logout notifications for your friends, and more.
Punchline.Translated: 改进游戏内好友系统，包括好友上线和下线通知等。

Description.Original:
Key Features:
- Receive notifications when friends using GoodFriend log in or out.
- Chat messages show how many of your friends are online when you log in.

Developer's Note on Using This Plugin After Patch 7.0:
As of Patch 7.0, some of the data that GoodFriend uses to identify players during login/logout events is now visible to anyone nearby your character in-game (not just your friends or party members). GoodFriend itself will still only show notifications for people you've added to your in-game friends list - however, please use this plugin only if you're comfortable with your login/logout activity being theoretically visible to nearby players (note: GoodFriend never sends data for users who don't have the plugin installed).

If you ever want to stop sending login/logout events, simply disable or uninstall the plugin. The server does not store any data about you.

For added privacy, you can now set a 'group key' in the plugin settings. This allows events to be shared only with people using the same key (for example, everyone in your raid group). When a group key is active, your events are never visible to anyone outside your group no matter what.
Description.Translated:
主要功能：
- 当使用 GoodFriend 的好友上线或下线时收到通知。
- 登录时聊天消息会显示有多少好友在线。

关于在 7.0 补丁后使用此插件的开发者说明：
自 7.0 补丁起，GoodFriend 用于在登录/登出事件中识别玩家的一些数据现在对游戏中你角色附近的任何人可见（不仅仅是你的好友或队员）。GoodFriend 本身仍然只会为你已添加到游戏内好友列表的人显示通知——但是，请仅在你对登录/登出活动理论上可被附近玩家看到感到放心的情况下使用此插件（注意：GoodFriend 从不为未安装该插件的用户发送数据）。

如果你随时想停止发送登录/登出事件，只需禁用或卸载该插件。服务器不存储任何关于你的数据。

为了增强隐私，你现在可以在插件设置中设置“组密钥”。这允许事件仅与使用相同密钥的人共享（例如，你团队中的所有人）。当组密钥激活时，无论什么情况，你的事件都不会对组外任何人可见。

Description.Original:
Improves the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing shortcuts. Works in all game text inputs: chat, macros, search, etc.

Supported shortcuts:
    - Ctrl + Left/Right: Jump between words
    - Ctrl + Shift + Left/Right: Select word by word
    - Ctrl + Backspace/Delete: Delete words
    - Ctrl + Insert: Copy
    - Shift + Insert: Paste
    - Shift + Delete: Cut

Changes:
    - Pressing Left/Right with the cursor at the start/end of an input properly clears the selection instead of doing nothing.
    - Clearing an active selection with Left/Right moves the cursor to the beginning/end of the selection.

Setting:

    - Ctrl + Backspace/Delete：删除单词
    - Ctrl + Insert：复制
    - Shift + Insert：粘贴

Punchline.Original: Yes. Still up. Press it.
Punchline.Translated: 是的。还在冷却。按它。

Description.Original:
Doing your rotation is hard enough without having to stare at your hotbars. This plugin helps you know exactly when an ability you actually care about is back up.

We don't want to clutter your screen with a massive status board. This won't show you everything that's currently available—instead, it stays completely empty until you use an ability in combat. Once you spend it and it comes off cooldown, the icon pops up to remind you. Press it, and it's gone again.

Because it only reminds you about things you've already used, it won't spam your screen before a pull. And for abilities with charges, it only pings when you go from 0 to 1—if you're sitting on a charge, it stays out of your way since you can already press it.

It's perfect for those key rotational abilities you really don't want to drift. You can also configure each ability so the reminder stays on screen until you press it, or quietly disappears after a few seconds.

/itsup → Open settings.
/itsup move → Unlock the bar to reposition it.
/itsup preview → Toggle preview mode.
/itsup reset → Reset the bar position and size.
Description.Translated:
光是盯着热键栏打循环就已经够难了。这个插件能帮你准确知道真正在意的技能什么时候转好。

我们不想用一大堆状态面板塞满你的屏幕。它不会显示当前所有可用的技能——相反，在战斗中你使用某个技能之前，它会一直保持空白。一旦你用掉它并进入冷却，图标就会弹出提醒你。按下它，图标又会消失。

因为它只提醒你已经用过的技能，所以开怪前不会刷屏。对于有充能的技能，它只会在你从 0 层变到 1 层时提示——如果你还留着充能，它不会打扰你，因为你本来就能按。

它非常适合那些你绝对不想延后的关键循环技能。你还可以为每个技能单独设置：提醒一直留在屏幕上直到你按下，或者几秒后悄悄消失。

/itsup → 打开设置。
/itsup move → 解锁状态栏以重新定位。
/itsup preview → 切换预览模式。
/itsup reset → 重置状态栏位置和大小。

Punchline.Translated: 查看市场板价格时，将最低报价减一后的数值复制到剪贴板

Description.Original:
Plugin for simplifying "pennying" (undercutting current lowest offer by 1).

The usual workflow for this is the following:
1. Open up the adjust price menu for the item you're undercutting
2. Click on the compare prices menu to view the current listings
3. Take a mental note of what the current lowest offer is
4. Subtract one from it
5. Close the current listings window
6. Update your item's price with the number you noted
7. Confirm your new price

This plugin eliminates the mental notekeeping steps in the middle by automatically copying the number you want onto your clipboard when you open the current listings window.  

Therefore, your new workflow becomes this:
1. Open up the adjust price menu for the item you're undercutting
2. Click on the compare prices menu to view the current listings
3. Close the current listings window
4. Paste the undercut value in
5. Confirm your new price

This both speeds up the process and reduces room for error from typos.
Description.Translated:
用于简化“压价”（将当前最低报价减一）的插件。

通常的流程如下：
1. 打开你要压价物品的调整价格菜单
2. 点击比价菜单查看当前在售列表
3. 记住当前最低报价是多少
4. 将其减一
5. 关闭当前在售窗口
6. 用你记下的数字更新物品价格
7. 确认你的新价格

此插件通过在你打开当前在售窗口时自动将你想要的数字复制到剪贴板，省去了中间手动记数的步骤。  

因此，你的新流程变为：
1. 打开你要压价物品的调整价格菜单
2. 点击比价菜单查看当前在售列表
3. 关闭当前在售窗口
4. 粘贴压价后的数值
5. 确认你的新价格

这既加快了流程，也减少了因输入错误而出错的可能。

Punchline.Original: Reminds you about retainer ventures.
Punchline.Translated: 提醒你雇员探险。

Description.Translated: 一个简单的插件，在你的雇员完成探险时提醒你。

Punchline.Translated: 更快查看雇员销售情况

曾经想要以更低解答所渲染吗？现在你可以了！
仅适用于 AMD FSR 图形升频器

Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内显示来自 Chaos Archives、Crystal Archives 和 Central Archives 的角色档案

Punchline.Original: A helper plugin for pre-populating hunt train scout tracker links

Description.Translated: 用于生成 A 级狩猎列车侦察追踪链接的辅助工具

Punchline.Original: Lets you use the mouse wheel to switch tabs (like LB/RB on controllers do).
Punchline.Translated: 让你使用鼠标滚轮切换标签页（如同手柄上的 LB/RB 那样）。

Punchline.Original: Get notified when someone enters or exits your mount!

Punchline.Original: Bringing Shananigans to Eorzea
Punchline.Translated: 将 Shananigans 带到艾欧泽亚

Description.Original: Replaces the word 'Gil' with 'Shanbells' (or something else entirely!) in the Currency window and Tooltips.
Description.Translated: 在货币窗口和提示框中将“Gil”一词替换为“Shanbells”（或完全替换为其他内容！）。

Punchline.Original: Displays item icons instead of item category icons in shops.
Punchline.Translated: 在商店中显示物品图标而非物品分类图标。

Description.Original:
Displays item icons instead of item category icons in shops.
      
Supported windows:

- Shops: Simple merchants that sell items for Gil.
- Item Exchange: Vendors that trade items for items, such as the Wolf Collar Exchange or Itinerant Moogles that exchange items for Irregular Tomestones during the Moogle Treasure Trove event.
- Item Exchange (categorized): Splendors Vendors, the Scrip Exchange or the Wolf Mark Exchange.
- Currency Exchange: Vendors that sell items for currency, such as all the societies vendors, or the Trophy Crystal Exchange.
- Grand Company Seal Exchange: Quartermasters of Grand Companies.
- Rewards: Vendors that provide job gear free of charge.
- Exchange: Calamity Salvager when exchanging old pigments for all-purpose pigments.
Description.Translated:
在商店中显示物品图标而非物品分类图标。
      
支持的窗口：

- 商店：以 Gil 出售物品的简单商人。
- 物品交换：以物品交换物品的商人，例如狼印兑换或莫古宝藏活动中以物品交换不规则的亚拉戈神典石的巡回莫古力。
- 物品交换（分类）：辉煌商人、票据兑换或狼印兑换。
- 货币兑换：以货币出售物品的商人，例如所有蛮族商人，或战利水晶兑换。
- 大国防联军军票兑换：大国防联军的军需官。
- 奖励：免费提供职业装备的商人。
- 交换：将旧颜料交换为万能颜料时的灾祸天翔回收人。

Punchline.Original: Shows you what items vendors won't sell you yet.
Punchline.Translated: 向你显示商人尚未出售给你的物品。

Description.Translated: 与受支持的商人对话时打开一个窗口，显示未解锁的物品及其条件。它会检查任务、成就和声望要求。

Punchline.Original: Automatically rename your screenshots with character and location info.
Punchline.Translated: 自动用角色和位置信息重命名你的截图。

Punchline.Translated: 用海盗语和于里昂热语等翻译让聊天更有趣。

允许你翻译玩家和 NPC 的聊天消息/气泡。

一系列生活质量调整。旨在改善体验而不做任何剧烈改变。

Punchline.Translated: 完全自定义你的物品栏

Punchline.Original: Filter any game sound.
Punchline.Translated: 过滤任何游戏音效。

- Remove specific emote sounds

Punchline.Translated: 一个 Dalamud 插件，允许在任何地方控制音量，包括 gpose 和过场动画。

Description.Translated: 一个 Dalamud 插件，允许在任何地方控制音量，包括 gpose 和过场动画。

Punchline.Original: Because multiplication is hard.
Punchline.Translated: 因为乘法太难了。

Description.Original: Shows the vendor sell price for the full stack of an item on the tooltip
Description.Translated: 在提示框中显示物品整组的商人出售价格

Punchline.Translated: 对你所做的精彩之事进行诙谐评论。

Description.Original: Check /narrator for full options or use /narratorvolume to set volume manually.
Description.Translated: 查看 /narrator 获取完整选项，或使用 /narratorvolume 手动设置音量。

Punchline.Original: Add contrast to your status icons
Punchline.Translated: 为你的状态图标增加对比度

Description.Original: You will finally be able to easily see the timer of your buffs/debuffs properly when the arena background is bright!
Description.Translated: 当竞技场背景明亮时，你终于能够轻松正确地看到增益/减益的计时器了！

Punchline.Original: Before StatusTimers, my buffs/debuffs were a mystery. Now, it's a well-organized history!
Punchline.Translated: 在 StatusTimers 之前，我的增益/减益是个谜。现在，它是一段井然有序的历史！

Description.Original: StatusTimers provides clear, customizable bars for tracking your crucial buffs and debuffs. It helps you keep an eye on active effects, their remaining durations, and stacks, allowing you to optimize your gameplay without constantly staring at your tiny icons.
Description.Translated: StatusTimers 提供清晰、可自定义的进度条，用于追踪你关键的增益和减益。它帮助你关注激活的效果、剩余持续时间和层数，让你优化游戏玩法，而无需一直盯着小小的图标。

Punchline.Original: Like /focustarget, but with no overrides.
Punchline.Translated: 类似 /focustarget，但没有覆盖。

Description.Original:
(PvE-only.) Adds the /stickyfocustarget command, which focuses your current
target, as long as you do not already have a focus target set.
  
Have you ever felt focusing was under-utilised? Wanted to use it without a
dedicated keybind? Do you not even know what focus targeting is?
You've come to the right place.
  
You can add this command to your Attack Nearest macro and ensure that the
first enemy you target will also become focused, and stay that way, until it dies.
With this, you can focus enemies without having to consciously press a keybind,
and ensure that, for instance, when a focused boss spawns an add and you target it,
the boss' focus will NOT get overriden.

This plugin does not change the behaviour of the stock /focustarget command,
and must be triggered either manually or by adding it to a macro.
Placeholders are supported.
Description.Translated:
（仅限 PvE。）添加 /stickyfocustarget 命令，在你尚未设置焦点目标时，将当前目标设为焦点。
  
你是否曾觉得焦点功能未被充分利用？想在不使用专用快捷键的情况下使用它？甚至不知道什么是焦点目标？
你来对地方了。
  
你可以将此命令添加到你的攻击最近目标宏中，确保你选中的第一个敌人也会成为焦点，并保持该状态直到它死亡。
有了这个，你无需刻意按下快捷键即可聚焦敌人，并确保例如当被聚焦的 Boss 召唤出小怪而你选中它时，Boss 的焦点不会被覆盖。

此插件不会改变原版 /focustarget 命令的行为，必须手动触发或添加到宏中。
支持占位符。

Punchline.Original: Gives the value of current targets health in Stormtalons from the dead game Wildstar.
Punchline.Translated: 以已停运游戏 Wildstar 中的 Stormtalons 为单位显示当前目标的生命值。

Description.Original: Gives the value of current targets health in Stormtalons from the dead game Wildstar.
Description.Translated: 以已停运游戏 Wildstar 中的 Stormtalons 为单位显示当前目标的生命值。

Punchline.Original: Colorizes suit symbols ♥, ♠, ♣, ♦
Punchline.Translated: 为花色符号 ♥、♠、♣、♦ 着色

Description.Translated: 启用后，花色符号会在聊天中以不同的颜色显示。

Punchline.Translated: 再也不会忘记你的 NPC 商店销售！

Description.Translated: 标记要出售给 NPC 的物品，并提醒你在 NPC 商店出售它们。

Punchline.Translated: 按需自动复制屏幕上的任意文本。

Punchline.Translated: 可自定义的目标线
